how_adapted: Adapted the precedence chain structure (add/sub -> term -> unary -> power with right-associative ^ whose exponent may carry a sign) into a new Parser class over a new tokenizer; rewrote for ES module, CalcError with position, no function/variable support, and added finite-result and division/remainder-by-zero checks. Tokenizer, number parsing and error messages are original.

Argument-list handling pattern (join argv, print result via console-style output, error message on failure) reimplemented for the spec: stderr 'Error: <message>' with exit code 1, usage message when no argument is given, ESM main-module guard. No other code reused; the library itself (string-slicing evaluator) was not used because it does not implement the spec's precedence (e.g. -2^2) or modulo/scientific notation.
